passive.name: Petricite Burst
passive.description: After casting a spell, Sylas stores a charge of Petricite Burst. Sylas's basic attacks will expend a charge and whirl his energized chains around him dealing bonus magic damage to enemies hit. While Sylas has a charge of Petricite Burst, he gains attack speed.

spells.name: Chain Lash
spells.description: Sylas lashes his chains out, dealing magic damage and Slowing by for seconds. The place where the chains intersect explodes, dealing a further magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Kingslayer
spells.description: Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing magic damage. Against champions, Sylas restores between and Health based on his missing Health (max healing at or below % Health).
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MinDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Abscond / Abduct
spells.description: Sylas quickly dashes, and prepares a Recast for 3.5 seconds. Recast: Sylas throws his chains, pulling himself to the first enemy hit, dealing magic damage, and Knocking Up for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Hijack
spells.description: Sylas hijacks an enemy champion, allowing him to cast a copy of their ultimate Ability, based on his Ultimate level and using his stats. Hijacking an enemy places a Cooldown on them for % (modified by Sylas' Ability Haste) of the enemy's ultimate's Cooldown, with a minimum of seconds, during which time Sylas cannot hijack them again.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
